get.summary: The Audit Log, newest first, filtered and a page at a time.
get.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` without `audit.read`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, in the Village's time zone.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, inclusive, in the Village's time zone.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries older than this one, such as the `next` of the previous page.

200.description: A page of matching Audit Entries

403.description: The User may not read the Audit Log

post.summary:
Exports every Audit Entry matching the filter as a CSV, masked like the Audit Log; see the
export mechanism.
post.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` without `audit.read`, `422` without a reason, `428`
outside sudo mode.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, in the Village's time zone.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, inclusive, in the Village's time zone.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries older than this one, such as the `next` of the previous page.

200.description: The matching Audit Entries as `log-audit.csv`, encrypted

403.description: The User may not read the Audit Log

post.summary:
Sets the User's password from their Access Link, which is then used up, and revokes every
session of theirs.
post.description:
# Errors
`404` for an unknown, used or expired link, `422` for a refused password.

204.description: The password is set and every session of the User revoked

404.description: The Access Link is unknown, used or expired

post.summary:
Signs in with a passkey instead of the password, starting a session held in the
`__Host-session` cookie.
post.description:
# Errors
`401`, the same for a decoy, an unknown, used or expired ceremony, a failed assertion and an
inactive User; `429` after 20 attempts a minute from the address.

204.description: Signed in; the response sets the session cookie

401.description: The passkey does not sign this User in

429.description: Too many attempts from the address; try again later

post.summary:
Starts signing in with a passkey for a username. A username that is unknown, inactive or
without passkeys gets a decoy challenge, so the answer never tells whether it exists.
post.description:
# Errors
`503` with too many ceremonies in flight.

503.description: Too many ceremonies are in flight; try again

get.summary: The signed-in User's passkeys, oldest first.

post.summary: Finishes adding a passkey for the signed-in User.
post.description:
# Errors
`400` for a credential that fails verification, `401` without a live session, `404` for an
unknown, used or expired ceremony or one another User started, `409` for a credential
already registered, `422` for a missing or over-long name, `428` outside sudo mode.

404.description: The ceremony is unknown, used or expired

422.description: The name is missing or too long

post.summary: Starts adding a passkey for the signed-in User, excluding the ones they already have.
post.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `428` outside sudo mode, `503` with too many ceremonies in flight.

503.description: Too many ceremonies are in flight; try again

delete.summary: Removes one of the signed-in User's passkeys.
delete.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `404` for a passkey that is not theirs, `428` outside sudo mode.

404.description: The User has no such passkey

put.summary:
Changes the signed-in User's password, under the same policy as at set-up, and ends every
other session of theirs.
put.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `422` for a refused password, `428` outside sudo mode.

204.description: The password is changed and every other session ended

post.summary: Confirms the signed-in User's password, entering sudo mode for 15 minutes.
post.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session or for a wrong password.

204.description: The password is right; sudo mode starts

401.description: There is no live session, or the password is wrong

get.summary: The signed-in User's live sessions, most recently active first.

post.summary: Signs in with a username and password, starting a session held in the `__Host-session` cookie.
post.description:
# Errors
`401`, the same for every wrong username or password; `429` without checking them, after 5
failures for the username or 20 attempts a minute from the address.

204.description: Signed in; the response sets the session cookie

401.description: The username or password is wrong

429.description: Too many attempts for the username or from the address; try again later

post.summary: Ends the current session and clears its cookie.

204.description: Signed out; the response clears the session cookie

post.summary: "Keluar dari perangkat lain": ends every session of the User but the current one.

204.description: Every other session of the User is ended

get.summary: The admin dashboard's figures, for any signed-in User.
Reports whether the API can reach its database.

200.description: The API and its database are up

get.summary:
An image's public rendition: `480`, `960` or `1600` (WebP) or `share` (JPEG). Cached
forever, since a file never changes; only images that hold no personal data come here.
get.description:
# Errors
`404` for an unknown file or variant.

404.description: There is no such file or variant

get.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role.

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

post.summary: Creates a Role from the Permission catalog.
post.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role, `409` for a taken
name, `428` outside sudo mode, `422` for a blank name or a Permission outside the catalog.

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

422.description: The name is blank or a Permission is unknown

put.summary: Renames a Role and replaces its Permissions; its Users hold them from their next request.
put.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role, `404` for an unknown
Role, `409` for the locked Administrator Role or a taken name, `428` outside sudo mode,
`422` as for creating.

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

409.description: The Role is the Administrator, or another Role has the name

422.description: The name is blank or a Permission is unknown

get.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role.

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

post.summary: Creates a User and their first Access Link.
post.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role, `409` for a taken
username, `422` for a malformed username or an unknown Role, `428` outside sudo mode.

201.description: The User and their Access Link

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

422.description: The username is malformed or the Role unknown

patch.summary:
Changes a User's Role or deactivates or reactivates them, never leaving the Village without
an active Administrator.
patch.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role, `404` for an unknown
User, `409` when no active Administrator would remain, `422` for an unknown Role, `428`
outside sudo mode.

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

409.description: It would leave no active Administrator

post.summary:
Resets a User's access: a new Access Link that voids the previous one, and every session
of theirs revoked.
post.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role, `404` for an unknown
User, `409` for an inactive User, `428` outside sudo mode.

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

delete.summary: Removes every passkey of a User, who can still sign in with their password.
delete.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role, `404` for an unknown
User, `428` outside sudo mode.

204.description: Every passkey of the User is removed

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

delete.summary: Signs a User out everywhere by revoking every session of theirs.
delete.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` outside the Administrator Role, `404` for an unknown
User, `428` outside sudo mode.

204.description: Every session of the User is revoked

403.description: The User is not an Administrator

get.summary: The Village's official identity; read-only, set by the vendor from the CLI.
get.description:
# Errors
`404` before the Village Code is set, `500` when the database is unreachable.

404.description: The Village Code is not set yet

post.summary: Stores a Village logo, a PNG or SVG of at most 2 MiB, for saving into the profile.
post.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` without `village.manage`, `413` over 2 MiB, `415`
for content that is not PNG or SVG, `422` over 40 megapixels or undecodable.

403.description: The User may not manage the Village

415.description: The file is not PNG or SVG

422.description: The image is too large or broken

put.summary: Replaces the Village's profile and its "Nomor Tanda Daftar PSE".
put.description:
# Errors
`401` without a live session, `403` without `village.manage`, `404` before the Village
Code is set, `422` for a malformed field or an unknown logo.

403.description: The User may not manage the Village

404.description: The Village Code is not set yet

422.description: A field is malformed or the logo is unknown

AccessLink.description: A fresh Access Link, shown once: the web app links to `/akses#<token>`.

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

userAgent.description: The browser's user agent at sign-in.

changes.description: The per-field diff of a data change.

details.description: Context for the action; never sensitive values, which go in `changes` to be masked.

username.description: The acting User's username, when the actor is a User.

entries.description: At most 50 Audit Entries, newest first.

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next, older page; null on the last page.

Dashboard.description: The figures behind the admin dashboard's cards.

EncryptedFile.description: An exported file, encrypted; only `password` opens it.

content.description: The AES-256 ZIP holding the one file, in base64.

password.description: The one-time password, to show once; Pranata keeps no copy.

ExportReason.description: Why the User exports; required (Permenkomdigi 5/2025 Art. 93) and kept in the Audit Entry.

FieldChange.description: One field's change in an Audit Entry.

sensitive.description: Whether `from` and `to` are shown as `•••` to readers without `resident.sensitive`.

role.description: The name of the User's Role.

name.description: 1–64 characters, such as the device it lives on.

username.description: 3–32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes; never changed or reused.

PasskeyChallenge.description: A WebAuthn ceremony's options for the browser, and its id to finish it with.

options.description: The ceremony options as JSON; `publicKey` goes to `PublicKeyCredential.parse…OptionsFromJSON`.

remember.description: "Ingat saya", as for a password sign-in.

lastUsedAt.description: When it last signed the User in; null if never.

PasswordProblem.description: Why a new password is refused.

Permission.description:
The fixed catalog of Permissions a Role can hold. Managing Users and Roles is not one:
it belongs to the Administrator Role alone.

administrator.description: The built-in, locked Administrator Role, which holds every Permission whatever `permissions` says.

name.description: Unique among Roles; surrounding spaces are dropped.

remember.description: "Ingat saya": 7 days idle and 30 days absolute instead of 30 minutes and 12 hours.

TimeZone.description: Indonesia's three time zones; the Village's drives every date-only rule.

id.description: The stored file, unreferenced until saved into its owner and swept after 24 h if not.

token.description: The token after `#` in the Access Link.

active.description: False once deactivated: the User can neither sign in nor keep a session.

passkeys.description: How many passkeys the User has.

role.description: The name of the User's Role.

active.description: `false` deactivates the User, revoking every session of theirs at once; `true` reactivates.

roleId.description: The User's new Role, held from their next request.

VillageProfile.description: What the Village edits about itself; its identity stays fixed by the Village Code.

latitude.description: The office's coordinates, both or neither, for the maps link.

pseNumber.description: The "Nomor Tanda Daftar PSE", shown in the public footer.
